Blind pack shipped unshuffled: 39/39 answers came off file index. Must shuffle + not self-judge.
S30 overruled by S35: map shows only travelled terrain + visited-place squares + own position. No objective markers. 'Distinguishable without map' is MORE load-bearing.

JUDGES assembled from front-matter: RI-AUD03[audio.ambience.region,world.region.identity], RI-WLD11[+world.weather.systems,world.region.identity], RI-WLD08[world.weather.systems,world.time.daynight], RI-TRV01[world.time.daynight], RI-WLD12[world.region.transition SOLE], RI-WLD09[world.strangeness.budget], RI-WLD14[world.strangeness.architecture SOLE]. RI-WLD04 and RI-WLD05 judge only LEGACY path names (world.regions/world.weather/world.strangeness/world.architecture) not the current taxonomy paths - corpus hole worth flagging.

W1-01-r4 handover: fog.height_falloff_m 45-340m is DECLARED PER REGION AND READ BY NOBODY (render/sky.js uses FogExp2, no height term). Their measured descriptor says the VERTICAL LUMINANCE PROFILE is the only half of the colour-stripped descriptor that carries signal (lum-only Fisher 1.528 vs edge-only 0.987). Height fog is therefore the highest-value region.identity lever available and it is squarely mine.
W1-01-r4 measured colour-stripped day structure on 39 frames: LOO 7.7% / Fisher 1.326. 3 frames/region makes LOO a coin flip.

Engine grep: region field 'fauna' is read by ZERO files. 'architecture' only by ui/surface.js. 'only_here' appears in renderer.js+engine.js (verify real). These are candidate CONSUMPTION failures for strangeness.architecture.

MEASURED CONSUMPTION FAILURE #1 (world.time.daynight): sim.env.timeOfDay is initialised to 12.0 in sim/state.js:182 and is NEVER advanced by the fixed step. grep of sim/step.js shows no env clock at all. Its ONLY writers are engine.js:4731 setTimeOfDay (harness verb), engine.js:4465/7118 (rest/advanceTime), and save/state.js:748 (load). This is exactly the RI-MTH07 pattern the brief named: a model whose only writer is a harness verb. There is no day/night CYCLE in the build.

MEASURED CONSUMPTION FAILURE #2 (world.weather.systems): sim.env.weather's only writers are engine.js:4737 setWeather (harness verb) and save load. No transition machine, no per-region weather selection, nothing reads regions.json .weather[] at runtime. render/sky.js's own comment says 'W1-02 owns the transition machine' - it was left for me.

GOOD NEWS - the downstream consumers are REAL and behavioural, so a clock/weather that moves will be demonstrable: sim/stealth/system.js:880-881 reads env.timeOfDay AND env.weather for detection; sim/souls.js:81-96 awards differently at night; sim/npc.js:147 picks a schedule slot from env.timeOfDay; sim/settlement.js:243 opens doors by hour; sim/hazards.js:154 stamps weather/hour. Perturbing the clock therefore changes entity behaviour.
render/sky.js DOES consume regionFog.colour/.extinction/.glow (per-region fog hue + night hue). It does NOT consume fog.height_falloff_m (FogExp2 has no height term) - confirms W1-01-r4's handover.

ALREADY BUILT BY W1-01, DO NOT REBUILD: only_here signatures are REAL - game/data/world/signatures.json has 840 instances, 13/13 regions, declared==placed for every region, 13 distinct kinds with real geometry in world/signature.js + signature-geo.js. world.strangeness.architecture EXISTENCE is met; the gap is grammar (RI-WLD14 F1-F8) not existence.
ALREADY BUILT: game/data/world/opacity.json (24 sealed mysteries) consumed by world/opacity.js OpacityRegister. world.strangeness.budget has a spine.

MEASURED CONSUMPTION FAILURE #3 (world.region.transition): field.regionAt(x,z) is a bare raster read - this.regions[this.regionU[cellIndex]]. All nine RI-WLD04 axes are fields of that one object, so ALL NINE CROSS AT EXACTLY THE SAME COORDINATE. stddev(c)=0 by construction, which is RI-WLD12's named AUTOMATIC FAIL ('the texture swap'). There is no border data anywhere in game/data/world.

RI-WLD08 §1 fixes the numbers I must build to: timescale 20x, full day/night 72 real minutes, 60/40 day-night split, 6-real-minute dawn/dusk, tide 12 real min (already built). §5: each region declares a weather state machine with >=4 STATES on a 20-real-minute tick, and no region shares another's full state set. regions.json currently declares 1-3 states (hive declares exactly one) - below the bar for all 13.

DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED in stealth: sim/stealth/system.js skyAmbient() classified only 3 weather ids as overcast ('overcast','storm','rain') out of the 20 render/sky.js already declared. heavy_rain, salt_storm, fever_fog, sea_squall, ashfall and every regional state were lit as MIDDAY SUN (ambient 1.00) by the stealth model while the renderer drew a black sky - the two halves of the build were looking at different weather. Now driven by weather.json's `light` class (sun/overcast/dark) republished on env.weatherLight, with a third 'dark' band (day 0.58 / night 0.06) below RI-STL01 §3's overcast row.

SHARED TREE WARNING: another agent has commented out `stepSouls(sim, bus);` in game/src/sim/step.js behind a 'DELETE-THE-FIX PROBE - restored immediately after' marker. Left untouched. If it is still commented out at your read, souls awards are OFF and that is not W1-02's doing.

CONSUMPTION DEMONSTRATED, 9/9 in tools/world/env-consumption.mjs, each with an in-band FROZEN-CLOCK negative control: A0 clock advances from the step not a verb (frozen drift 0.000000000 h); A1 259,200 frames = one game day = 72 real minutes exactly; C1 stealth outdoor ambient moves 15:00->dusk while the frozen control holds to 1e-9; C2 souls night multiplier fires at 22:00 and not on the frozen control; C3 the weather machine rolls in all 13 regions over 14 ticks and never lands in an undeclared state; C4 every state changes the frame in every region; C5 two runs byte-identical, no RNG/clock; C6 night_cold is chosen 227/400 at 01:00 and 5/400 at 12:00.
SABOTAGE CONTROL RUN: changing the clock increment from +1 to +0 takes the probe from 9/9 to 5/9 (A0, A1, C1, C2 all go red). The instrument can fail.

SECOND MODEL DEFECT, found by my own probe and fixed: sky.js was combining the region's fog extinction with the weather's by Math.max(). In the four regions whose own extinction is already high (blackwood 0.018/m, hive, marauders-coast, stone-forest) the region term beat EVERY state its machine can roll, so weather changed the frame by exactly nothing in 4 of 13 regions - RI-WLD08's 'weather as a colour grade' arriving through a Math.max. Extinction coefficients add; now additive, and all 13 regions show 4 distinct realised sightlines.

THIRD PROBE DEFECT, self-caught: the first C2 called awardFor('str', h) - awardFor takes a STATBLOCK and returns souls 0 for anything with no .souls field, so the check passed vacuously against a placeholder. Rewritten against a real stat and a hour inside RI-PRG04's 21:00-05:00 window.

RI-WLD12 M65 MEASURED ON THE LIVE FIELD: 24 of 24 borders pass. stddev(c) over the nine axes min 16.49 m / median 22.82 m / max 62.03 m; every HARD >= 8 m and every MARKED >= 25 m; MARKED span min 108 m >= 60 m. ZERO automatic fails (stddev < 5 m). Canonical order holds on every border: palette > flora > weather > fauna > audio > {hazard,tier} > architecture > only_here. Before this the same measurement was stddev 0 on all 24 by construction.

M64 inventory: 24 walkable adjacencies, 58% HARD (bar 40%), 8 distinct threshold-object types in use (bar 6), graded widths 123-172 m (bar 120-180), 210 objects placed, 0 borders with neither a landform nor an object, 7 borders with |dtier|>=2 all carrying a 2-channel announcement.

THREE INSTRUMENT DEFECTS FOUND BY RUNNING THE TRAVERSE AGAINST THE LIVE FIELD RATHER THAN THE DECLARED OFFSETS - each would have shipped a wrong number: (1) the signed distance raster is 25 m/cell, so nearest-neighbour reads made nine crossovers 5.5 m apart land in the SAME cell - 23 of 24 borders had 5-6 axis pairs inside the 3 m limit while the data was correct. Fixed by bilinear interpolation, which also stopped the ground colour changing in 25 m squares. (2) anchoring the traverse at the border's NARROWEST point put it where the distance band is thinnest, so the walk left the band before the early axes handed over and every axis flipped together at the raster line - a perfect texture swap on 3 of 24 from a correct build. (3) a STRAIGHT perpendicular is perpendicular only where it was fitted; on a curving frontier arc length and signed distance come apart and the ruler bends. The walk now follows the gradient at every step.

RESIDUAL, declared: marauders-coast--western-rootlands resolves only 6 of 9 axes in a 400 m traverse - the band does not reach far enough on one side for hazard/architecture/only_here. Its 6 resolved axes give stddev 26.45 m, above the bar, but it is a partial measurement and should be read as such.
